item.title: Version 1.11.3
item.description: Version 1.11.3 - Add Git Client / Code Editor quick tools, a sortable project list, and full doc + SWIFTSTYLE conformance - Move the Claude config browser into a Settings pane and add a Plan empty-state icon

item.title: Version 1.11.1
item.description:
Version 1.11.1 - Enable string catalog symbol generation and adopt the Xcode 26.6 project defaults - Move the last local packages to remote swifts and conform the app target to SWIFTSTYLE
System requirements:
macOS 26 or higher, with Apple Intelligence enabled

item.title: Version 1.10.7
item.description:

macOS 26 or higher, with Apple Intelligence enabled

item.title: Version 1.10.5
item.description:

item.title: Version 1.10.4
item.description:
Version 1.10.4 - Consume the four external spm* packages as pinned remote dependencies and sync the docs - Make the Plan/ToDo/Session/Agent markdown sheets user-resizable - Wire the real Sparkle appcast URL + EdDSA public key and fix a Swift 6 self-capture in ReachabilityService
System requirements:
macOS 26 or higher, with Apple Intelligence enabled
